cards.title: Document / Style
cards.body:
Character lineup model sheet · concept art sheet
#07 · HiDrive-Anime-Vector · Guilty Gear (2D) / BlazBlue
PS2 / Arcade / Arc System Works
Artist ref: Daisuke Ishiwatari · Guilty Gear art/design reference
Signature: Angular silhouettes, aggressive ink, high contrast

cards.title: Lineart
cards.body:
Very clean fine vector-like contours
Streamlined angular silhouettes
Deep navy outline #000055

cards.title: Morphology
cards.body:
Modern anime-fighter anatomy
Adapted to tall, slim ectomorph
Long limbs; no bulky or chibi redesign

cards.title: Shading
cards.body:
Crisp geometric two-tone cel shadows
Clean vivid material planes
No texture, gradients, or effects

cards.title: Biotype
cards.body:
Selected: tall, slim ectomorph
Options: ectomorph · mesomorph · endomorph
muscular · petite · slim · athletic · curvy
heavy muscular · short

cards.title: Relative Scale
cards.body:
H = crown-to-chin head height · target ~7.5H
Orthographic views share scale and baseline
Visual guide, not canonical absolute height

cards.title: Palette / Effects
cards.body:
Fixed identity colors: blue/cyan, teal, white, gray, burgundy, brown
Brass details; violet only on boomerang effect
Concept illustration; colors not quantized

cards.title: Background / Alignment
cards.body:
Clean neutral cream · no scenery or texture
Horizontal lineup · common scale and baseline

cards.title: Fixed Character Details
cards.body:
Gray hair · round brass glasses · cane · rapier
Steel crescent boomerang · fully human; no monster traits

artistic_style_reference.reference_role_and_scope: Creator and authorial visual-direction reference for the original Guilty Gear; not sole character-art or sprite credit.
artistic_style_reference.basis_and_limits: Traits are an editorial reading of the selected Guilty Gear visual reference.

annotation_revision.preserved_artwork_note: Artwork is preserved from the versioned source. For card-only revisions, all pixels outside the document/style card are unchanged.
